reason: Critical spec-alignment and logic issues remain (metrics naming/missing, policy schedule activation bug, missing validation criteria, and state mutation within modules). These are high-impact fixes that are feasible within the remaining iterations and will significantly improve correctness and evaluability. With 3 iterations left, prioritizing these changes can bring the model to spec compliance and enable meaningful validation/calibration.

specific_areas: Fix policy schedule activation to use the schedule event day as the effective start day in GovernmentPolicyModule.forward

Align metrics with the spec in compute_summary_metrics: peak_adoption_rate, time_to_70_percent, sustained_adoption_at_horizon, compliance_by_location, enforcement_actions_count, mask_shortage_days, adoption_inequality_index, policy_effect_increment, plus keep backward-compatible aliases
Implement validation criteria: target_adoption_threshold, stability_after_horizon (last-14-day variance), replicate_consistency across seeds, optional calibration_rmse when observed data provided
Refactor AdoptionDecisionModule and RetailMarketModule to return person_updates/retailer_updates (no direct mutation) and commit retailer_updates in Simulation._commit_updates
Make calibration evaluator meaningful: compute RMSE/MAE/Brier against observed series if provided; else return None with clear flag
Support nested parameters.location_visit_rates, exogenous_risk_signal integration, and add mask_fatigue_rate_per_day in decision utility
Optional if time permits: Add a simple HouseholdNormsModule to propagate norms within households
Minor cleanups: remove unused imports and unused variables in scale_free_graph

task_understanding.adjustments: Enforce strict adherence to spec key names and required outputs; treat naming/alias mismatches as blockers; prioritize policy timing logic correctness.

data_analysis.adjustments: Prepare ingestion and alignment of observed adoption trajectories if provided; define rolling window metrics (e.g., 14-day variance) and cross-seed aggregation for replicate consistency.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan a minimal refactor to buffer-based updates for adoption and retail modules; define validation acceptance thresholds and a test matrix covering policy schedule scenarios and metrics availability.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement metric additions/aliases, schedule bug fix, validation function, and update-commit pattern; add exogenous risk and nested visit rates support; include unit tests for schedule activation and metric keys.

code_verification.adjustments: Add automated checks for presence and names of required metrics; assert no direct state mutations in modules under test; test policy_type_sequence activation timing; static checks for unused imports/variables.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run multi-seed batches for validation; ensure deterministic seeding; expose an option to pass observed data for calibration; verify performance at target scale after refactor.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Report new metrics (peak, sustained, enforcement actions) and validation outcomes; compute calibration errors when data is present; clearly mark unavailable metrics as None, not zero.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide a concise diff of fixed vs pending spec items; highlight any remaining gaps blocking acceptance; include guidance on interpreting new metrics and validation results.
